name: Find remote Podman lock
command: set -euo pipefail; env_file="${UA_WHATBOX_ENV_FILE:-${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/upload-assistant/whatbox.env}"; set -a; source "$env_file"; set +a; export SSHPASS="$UA_WHATBOX_PASSWORD"; timeout 45 sshpass -e ssh -4 -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o ServerAliveInterval=5 -o ServerAliveCountMax=2 -o PubkeyAuthentication=no -o PreferredAuthentications=password -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes artemisprime@destiny.whatbox.ca 'ps -eo pid,ppid,stat,etime,args | grep -E "[p]odman|[c]onmon|[u]pload.py|[h]elmd" | head -100'
description: Find orphaned remote Podman or Upload Assistant commands that may be holding Destiny’s runtime lock.
